items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (flushChunk, readNextChunk, decodeAndValidateKey) and formatting matches the repo. But no exported API (NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config.Validate) has a doc comment, and single-letter `k` is used for key copies in business logic.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Split into config.go and encryption.go is clean and functions are short. But an unused `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` wrapper is left as dead code. Key-copy and cipher setup is duplicated in EncryptWriter and DecryptReader, and save() re-runs Encryption.Validate().

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Constants are named (NonceSize, MaxChunkSize, SentinelSize). Chunk length is bounds-checked. Truncation maps to ErrUnexpectedEOF, hmac.Equal is used, writer errors are sticky, Close is idempotent and returns the stored error, and the key is copied. Closers run in order: gzip, then encrypt, then pipe.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Mandated signatures changed and callers updated; unencrypted output and filenames are unchanged. But storage.PathGenerator hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)`, wrapping the caller instead of updating it. It also adds extras: an unexported validate() shim and many exported constants.
